# CMake build for HAMACODEX.framework (iOS) — generated by Kodeing dylib foundry.
# CMake builds one SDK per build tree, so configure both and merge them:
#   cmake -S . -B build-cmake/iphoneos -DCMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT=iphoneos -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES=arm64
#   cmake -S . -B build-cmake/iphonesimulator -DCMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT=iphonesimulator -DCMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES="arm64"
#   cmake --build build-cmake/iphoneos && cmake --build build-cmake/iphonesimulator
#   xcodebuild -create-xcframework \
#     -framework build-cmake/iphoneos/HAMACODEX.framework \
#     -framework build-cmake/iphonesimulator/HAMACODEX.framework \
#     -output build-cmake/HAMACODEX.xcframework
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)

set(CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME iOS)
set(CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT "iphoneos" CACHE STRING "iphoneos or iphonesimulator")
set(CMAKE_OSX_ARCHITECTURES "arm64" CACHE STRING "Target architectures")
set(CMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET "undefined" CACHE STRING "Minimum iOS version")

project(HAMACODEX VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif()

add_library(HAMACODEX SHARED src/HAMACODEX.cpp include/HAMACODEX.h)
target_include_directories(HAMACODEX PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
set_target_properties(HAMACODEX PROPERTIES
  FRAMEWORK TRUE
  OUTPUT_NAME HAMACODEX
  PUBLIC_HEADER include/HAMACODEX.h
  MACOSX_FRAMEWORK_IDENTIFIER com.hama.codex
  MACOSX_FRAMEWORK_INFO_PLIST ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/framework/Info.plist
  INSTALL_NAME_DIR "@rpath"
  BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_NAME_DIR ON
  MACHO_CURRENT_VERSION 1.0.0
  MACHO_COMPATIBILITY_VERSION 1.0.0
  CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
  CXX_STANDARD 17
  CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON
)
target_link_options(HAMACODEX PRIVATE "LINKER:-exported_symbols_list,${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/exports.txt")

# Module map so Swift can `import HAMACODEX` and Objective-C can `@import HAMACODEX;`.
add_custom_command(TARGET HAMACODEX POST_BUILD
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory $<TARGET_BUNDLE_CONTENT_DIR:HAMACODEX>/Modules
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/framework/module.modulemap
          $<TARGET_BUNDLE_CONTENT_DIR:HAMACODEX>/Modules/module.modulemap
)
